event.description: Union closest block-0 pre-FF norm biases 14 and 1
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,479 parameters at 99.200000%, a +0.200000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 82 prior macro-attempts in this family and 672 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0185/micro-0002 at 1479 parameters and 99.200000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0184/micro-0001 (discard, 98.040000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of block 0's pre-feed-forward normalization biases: union coordinates 14 and 1, values -0.0736862943 and -0.0573899411 (difference 1.630e-02), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: additive centering has local redundancy distinct from the measured scale boundary, preserving qualification at 1,478 parameters. It is more informative than the next bias union (difference 1.654e-02) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated bias test; scales remain fixed. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
